name: stream-box
title: Stream Box
description: A collapsible box for streamed model output with a title and character count. It follows the end of the text as it grows until the reader scrolls up.
usage:
<StreamBox title="Thinking" text={thinking} streaming />

<StreamBox title="Thought for 1:31" meta="Whole request 2:16" text={thinking} defaultOpen={false} />
notes: Pass the text received so far and re-render as chunks arrive. While streaming the header shows a pulsing dot and the text ends in a blinking cursor. Scrolling up stops the follow; scrolling back to the bottom or reopening the box resumes it.

The content is not a live region, so screen readers are not flooded while tokens arrive. Announce the finished result elsewhere. Pass children instead of text to render your own content, such as highlighted code.
